test_cases.title: Homepage renders without an obvious user-facing error

steps.action: Confirm the Emids website is available.
Check the homepage response and visible content.
steps.expected: The homepage returns a successful response, displays its expected branding and hero content, and shows no obvious error page.

test_cases.title: A main navigation menu opens its intended destination

steps.action: Open the Emids homepage with the main navigation available.
Open each Solutions, Capabilities, Industries, Insights, and Company menu and select its representative destination.
Check the resulting destination after each selection.
steps.expected: The corresponding Solutions, Data Engineering, Payer, Insights Hub, or Our Story page opens.

test_cases.title: Contact and learn-more calls to action open their intended pages

steps.action: Open the Emids homepage containing the primary calls to action.
Select the Contact Us action currently labelled "Connect".
Return to the homepage and select the learn-more action labelled "See How We Deliver Outcomes".
steps.expected: The forward-deployed context engineering page opens.

test_cases.title: Core homepage content and controls remain usable on mobile

steps.action: Open the Emids homepage in a 390 by 844 mobile viewport.
steps.expected: Core text, the brand image, mobile menu control, and primary action are visible.
The mobile navigation and contact action are visible and usable.

steps.action: Close the menu and select the primary homepage action.
steps.expected: The action's destination opens successfully in the mobile viewport.

test_cases.title: Empty required fields prevent contact form submission

steps.action: Open the contact form with every required field empty.
Attempt to submit the contact form.
steps.expected: Submission is prevented and the user remains on the contact form.

steps.action: Check validation feedback for all required fields.
steps.expected: Every required field displays a clear required-field validation message.
